configuration.lsp.path.description: Executable used to start the local recite-lsp language server. A bare name is resolved through PATH; a path is resolved relative to the project root.
configuration.lsp.args.description: Arguments passed to recite-lsp without a shell. The server currently speaks LSP over stdio.
configuration.lsp.projectRoot.descriptio: Optional project root for language-server discovery. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. Leave empty to use the workspace folder.
